title: POST on submit, analytics on display

slides.say: A form sends two POST requests: an analytics visit, and a register request on submit. Where does each belong?
The analytics event is sent because the form was displayed. That stays in an Effect.
Registering happens because the user pressed submit, at one moment. Put it in the event handler, not in an Effect watching some state.

slides.text: Ask: caused by an interaction? Handler. Caused by being seen? Effect.
slides.say: The question: is it caused by a particular interaction? Event handler. Is it caused by the user seeing the component? Effect.
